summary: Crow's nest near Potlatch, Idaho, dated to about 1918; staffed by 1928, abandoned in the 1930s; wire and planks found in 2022, so status is ruins, not gone.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1930s; a 2022 Idaho Fire Lookouts visit found telephone wire and planks, not a standing lookout

corrections.why: The firelookout.org Idaho list gives this site as Crowsnest, Abandoned, not Gone, and the 2022 Idaho Fire Lookouts visit found wire and planks at the site. The record's ffla=gone conflict value does not match that page.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com's 'Still there 1980s' dates the crow's nest and does not say it stands today. The 2022 visit found remains only, so the status is ruins, not standing.

Firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts say St. Joe National Forest; Idaho Fire Lookouts says St Joe Clearwater National Forest. The record keeps St. Joe National Forest, the name two of the three pages use.

notes_for_editor: Record status gone is not supported by the firelookout.org list, which says Abandoned; the proposed correction is ruins. The 1928 Daily Panidan item also includes an unrelated anecdote about a rescued man, which the story leaves out. The abandonment year is only a decade in every source. The site-today description rests on one 2022 hobby-site post. No photos added. Searches did not turn up a Forest Service record. Revised 2026-10-10: the story now dates the 2022 visit and no longer says no source describes the remains (the 2022 post does); 'first structure' is now 'earliest structure listed'.
